# AI Actually

> AI Actually is a personal AI in development that is being built to protect people, at any age and on their own devices, from AI used against them: AI scam calls, cloned voices and deepfakes; AI tools and agents that act without permission; and chatbots that manipulate or push too far. It is not available yet. There is no app, no price, and no launch date. People can join the early access list on the homepage.

## Status

In development, research stage. Nothing is for sale. Early access members will hear first when there is a version to try and when pricing is decided.

## What it is being built to do

- **Scam calls, cloned voices, and deepfakes.** Help a person check a call, text, or message that doesn't add up. They forward it or describe it, and get a plain answer and what to do next, before they pay.
- **AI tools that act without asking.** Watch the AI apps and agents a person already uses, and check with them before one buys, sends, or shares something they didn't approve.
- **Chatbots and AI companions.** Notice when an AI chat is pushing the person, flattering them into sharing more than they meant to, or steering them somewhere they didn't choose.

## The problem, with sources

- FBI IC3 2025 Internet Crime Report: https://www.ic3.gov/AnnualReport/Reports/2025_IC3Report.pdf (22,364 AI-related complaints with adjusted losses over $893 million; people 60+ reported $7.7 billion in losses of all kinds).

## Who is building it

Anthony Proctor, founder, Denver, Colorado. AI Actually is independent and takes no money or referral fees from any AI company or security product.
